content.material_limit: B1 brick_load = small unwrapped cored red bricks; Roboflow brick_load = shrink-wrapped large perforated clay block pallets (Porotherm-like, inferred). Different material and label definition (real = one target per image). Results must NOT be read as same-material real generalisation of red bricks; real metrics describe transfer/adaptation to the Roboflow product and site.

content.camera_condition_values_source: Train full-family distances only, within each existing distance_bin; fixed pre-inference

content.annotation_policy: original target-only Roboflow labels from accepted B1 LOCKED v03; no label repair; different product/site domain
content.checkpoint_rule: each representation: max .5*own C-V02 Val Mask mAP5095 + .5*realVal Mask mAP5095; strict greater, ties earliest epoch
content.real_only_rule: three seed trajectories shared; evaluate all3 C Val domains and save per-rep balanced checkpoint (may differ by epoch); no redundant real-only training
content.common_ratio_rule: maximum equal mean of balanced checkpoint scores over3 reps x3 seeds; exact ties prefer higher synthetic fraction in fixed ratio order; Test never used

content.mean_SD: over3training seeds within each representation; not9independent real-only trainings
